extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Intuitive definition of limit; found from tables, graphs, and algebraically

extracted_concepts.name: Average Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate of change over an interval; slope of the secant line

extracted_concepts.name: Instantaneous Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate of change at an instant; limit of average rates

extracted_concepts.name: Squeeze Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If g(x) ≤ f(x) ≤ h(x) and lim g = lim h = L, then lim f = L

extracted_concepts.name: Continuity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f is continuous at a if lim_{x→a} f(x) = f(a)

extracted_concepts.name: Asymptote
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Horizontal and vertical asymptotes connected to limits at infinity

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f'(a) = lim_{h→0} [f(a+h) - f(a)]/h

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Line touching a curve at a point with slope given by the derivative

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Differentiable implies continuous

extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(xⁿ) = nxⁿ⁻¹

extracted_concepts.name: Product Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: (fg)' = f'g + fg'

extracted_concepts.name: Quotient Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: (f/g)' = (f'g - fg')/g²

extracted_concepts.name: Implicit Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Differentiating equations not solved for y

extracted_concepts.name: Inverse Function Derivative Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If y = f(x) and x = g(y), then g'(y) = 1/f'(g(y))

extracted_concepts.name: Related Rates
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If two quantities change with time, relate their rates

extracted_concepts.name: Linearization
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: L(x) = f(a) + f'(a)(x-a)

extracted_concepts.name: L'Hôpital's Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: For 0/0 or ∞/∞: lim f/g = lim f'/g'

extracted_concepts.name: Extreme Value Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f has absolute max/min on [a,b]

extracted_concepts.name: Critical Point
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Point where f' is zero or undefined; candidate for extrema

extracted_concepts.name: First Derivative Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Classify critical points using the sign of f'

extracted_concepts.name: Second Derivative Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f'(c) = 0, f''(c) > 0 → local min

extracted_concepts.name: Concavity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f'' > 0 → concave up, f'' < 0 → concave down

extracted_concepts.name: Riemann Sum
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Left, right, midpoint sums approximating area

extracted_concepts.name: Definite Integral
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ∫_a^b f(x)dx = lim Σ f(xᵢ*)Δx

extracted_concepts.name: Antiderivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: F with F' = f; used in ∫_a^b f(x)dx = F(b) - F(a)

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx ∫_a^x f(t)dt = f(x); ∫_a^b f(x)dx = F(b) - F(a)

extracted_concepts.name: u-Substitution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: u-substitution (chain rule in reverse)

extracted_concepts.name: Differential Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equation involving dy/dx; model situations and verify solutions

extracted_concepts.name: Separation of Variables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ∫g(y)dy = ∫f(x)dx

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Growth Model
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: dy/dt = ky → y = Ce^(kt)

extracted_concepts.name: Parametric Equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: x = f(t), y = g(t), dy/dx = g'(t)/f'(t)

extracted_concepts.name: Polar Coordinates
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Points given by (r, θ); polar area A = ½∫r²dθ

extracted_concepts.name: Infinite Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Convergent and divergent infinite series

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: S = a₁/(1-r) for |r| < 1

extracted_concepts.name: Ratio Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: L = lim |aₙ₊₁/aₙ|, converges if L < 1

extracted_concepts.name: Taylor Polynomial
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Pₙ(x) = Σf⁽ᵏ⁾(a)(x-a)ᵏ/k!

extracted_concepts.name: Power Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Representing functions as power series; radius and interval of convergence
